purpose: verify-the-verifier fixtures for check_bundle_parity.py (VLOOP Item 4). Each entry is a defect CLASS the gate must catch; recipes regenerate the planted bundle from any clean bundle so the fixtures never go stale.

operand_pinning.empirical_confirmation: v2.4: 77/77 files match with ZERO normalization -> raw decoded text is the exact operand; 0 stored files contain CR

defect_classes.name: content-drift
defect_classes.motivating_defect: a bundled multi-file skill's engine silently lagged the live tool by several files (F5)

defect_classes.name: omitted-file
defect_classes.recipe: delete a non-SKILL.md file from a skill's files{} and from its manifest entry
defect_classes.motivating_defect: a bundle that silently omits a file would otherwise pass, since MISSING only checks the other direction

defect_classes.name: malformed-yaml
defect_classes.recipe: replace a SKILL.md with an unterminated frontmatter block

defect_classes.name: empty-description
defect_classes.recipe: SKILL.md with 'description:' and no value, manifest REPAIRED so this is the only defect
defect_classes.motivating_defect: adversarial review: 'an empty-but-valid YAML must not pass'. THIS FIXTURE CAUGHT A REAL FALSE-GREEN in the checker: str(None)=='None' is non-empty, so str(v).strip() passed a null mandatory key. Fixed by an explicit None test.
defect_classes.expected: mandatory key 'description' missing or empty (value=None), exit 2

defect_classes.name: manifest-mismatch
defect_classes.recipe: overwrite one manifest sha with 64 zeros
defect_classes.motivating_defect: a manifest written from different bytes than the bodies beside it

defect_classes.name: name-not-equal-dir
defect_classes.recipe: change frontmatter 'name:' to differ from the skill dir name; repair manifest
defect_classes.expected: frontmatter name != skill dir name, exit 2

defect_classes.name: null-name
defect_classes.recipe: SKILL.md with 'name:' and no value; repair manifest
defect_classes.expected: mandatory key 'name' missing or empty (value=None), exit 2
